messages:
emily: PR #459 (sdk/snippets/js-streaming) failed docs CI: markdownlint + linkcheck + vale. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/459
rafael: what did the logs say? paste the short errors
emily: linkcheck: Broken anchor -> /api/streaming#response-streams  (404)
markdownlint: MD032/blanks-around-headings: Expected single blank line before heading at line 88
vale: Warning ProseUse: 'utilise' found in examples -> prefer 'use'
priyanka: anchor rename happened during the streaming API refactor. should point to /api/streaming#response-streaming now. I can push a fix for that and add the missing blank line
rafael: also check the snippet header comment — very long line triggered MD013/line-length. wrap comments at 100 chars
emily: I'll push three tiny fixes: anchor, blank line, wrap comment. prepping commit now
ci-bot: build started for PR #459 (docs-preview + linkcheck + markdownlint + vale)
priyanka: note for the anchor: use relative link `/api/streaming#response-streaming` to avoid preview host mismatches
emily: pushed commit 1782456842 - replaced anchor, added blank line, reflowed long comment with `//` wraps
ci-bot: preview logs: linkcheck passed; markdownlint still warns about MD013 at line 55 in code block due to long inline URL
rafael: that inline URL is the websocket example: `wss://stream.example.com/connect?token=<TOKEN>&session=<SESSION_ID>` - maybe shorten in text and include full URL in a separate code block
priyanka: or use `<WSS_ENDPOINT>` placeholder in inline text and show full connect URL in a fenced code block to avoid line-length rule
emily: pushed commit 1782456870 - replaced inline URL with placeholder and added full URL in code fence
ci-bot: vale still flagged 'utilise' at line 23 (different file than before?)
rafael: odd — maybe duplicated snippet included via include directive. search for 'utilise' across the PR
priyanka: found it in examples/streaming.md include. changing to 'use' now
emily: pushed commit 1782456885 - removed 'utilise' -> 'use'
ci-bot: all checks passed. requesting review from @docs-engineer
docs-engineer: quick content pass - examples render and headings spacing fixed. tiny nit: replace `// TODO` in code sample with an actual short note. Updated and approved.
ci-bot: PR #459 merged by docs-bot at 1782456897
emily: thanks team. opened follow-up issue #228 to scan for British variants (utilise, behaviour) in docs repo
rafael: good call. that will reduce Vale churn
priyanka: closing thread :white_check_mark:
